# El Coso 3000

> Free, browser-based generator for image, animated-image, and video placeholders. Files are rendered locally and nothing is uploaded. The page works offline after it has loaded; the standalone HTML download can be opened offline.

## Main pages

- [Generator](https://maranimatias.github.io/el-coso-3000/): Create and download placeholders.
- [Standalone HTML](https://maranimatias.github.io/el-coso-3000/placeholder.html): Download the self-contained offline version.
- [Source code](https://github.com/MaraniMatias/el-coso-3000): Application source and issue tracker.
- [README](https://github.com/MaraniMatias/el-coso-3000/blob/main/README.md): Usage, formats, and known limits.

## Capabilities

- Choose custom dimensions from 1 to 4096 pixels per side.
- Still image formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, and SVG.
- Animated and sequence formats: GIF, Motion JPEG AVI, and ZIP files of numbered JPEG frames.
- Video containers: MP4, WebM, MOV, and MKV. A soundtrack is optional and can be a synthesized tango, beep, tone, or noise. Audio encoder support depends on the browser.
- Transparent output is available for PNG, WebP, SVG, and GIF. GIF transparency is binary; JPEG, AVI, ZIP, and the video containers do not support transparency.
- The background can be flat, one of four animated textures (bokeh with grain, the default for video; fog, the default for images; center focus; and rising spheres), or a custom color picked from the mosaic. Textures are painted into the file for every canvas-based format, including all video containers; SVG stays flat. On an output with more than one frame their speed can be set from 1x to 3x, 2x being the default, and turning Texture movement off holds the background still. Textures are not seamless when a video loops.
- Text displays the dimensions, and its color is calculated from the selected background to guarantee WCAG contrast. Both colors can be picked by hand from the same row: the last swatch is painted in two halves, its large triangle opening the picker for the background and its small one for the text. Whichever of the two is picked, the other one is computed from it, and the indicator under the row says which one is following. Picking both by hand keeps the pair as it is, so its contrast is reported and may fall below AA, and a fix button appears in that row, only while the pair cannot be read, to hand the text back to the computed color. When the background is transparent, visible contrast depends on the background behind the exported file.
- Video and animated exports can include a progress bar and time display.

## Privacy and limits

- Rendering, encoding, and downloads happen in the browser; files are not uploaded.
- Video export requires browser WebCodecs and support for the requested encoder. Audio tracks additionally require a supported audio encoder.
- Video exports are limited to 3600 frames. H.264 may round odd dimensions up to even values.
- GIF frame timing is quantized, so the resulting frame rate may differ from the requested rate.
